modern_caller.behavior: Confirmed Yes sets returnToFrontend. Before leaving gameplay, current main calls skill-cast and CombatSession lifecycle checkpoint; on quiescent living player it saves GameSave then CharacterState; if dead it skips GameSave but currently writes CharacterState. Checkpoint failure skips both saves but still leaves the loop. The frontend route reconstructs menu options after the loop.

entrypoints: commit_v1(TicketV1&, RuntimeSkillCastCoordinatorV1&, level URI, live-save path, profile path, CharacterState&, CommitV1&, error)
implementation.behavior: Request requires authored Yes confirmation, exact live Session and source-skill checkpoint owner, then calls actual coordinator checkpoint and Session lifecycle checkpoint. A single-use ticket binds same Session lease and update serial. Commit revalidates both checkpoints and the same coordinator, synchronizes current HP/MP from the live player, writes GameSave first for a living player and profile second through existing save providers, and publishes staged CharacterState only after successful profile write. Dead player path skips world save but persists actual dead profile.

main_integration_contract: Call request_v1 before latching/switching the confirmed frontend route. If it rejects, retain gameplay/pause and both saves. If admitted, call commit_v1 synchronously in the same Session boundary before setting returnToFrontend; only successful commit allows Session teardown and menu reconstruction. Preserve the same Session, coordinator, CharacterState and selected save paths through commit. Do not route on save failure.
